t: 瓦雷鲁国王发现了汉萨瓦底王国,并宣布从帕干王国独立.
te: King Wareru founds the Hanthawaddy kingdom, and proclaims independence from the Pagan Kingdom.
dz: 瓦雷鲁国王发现了汉萨瓦底王国,并宣布从帕干王国独立.
de: King Wareru founds the Hanthawaddy kingdom, and proclaims independence from the Pagan Kingdom.

t: 忽必烈在东蒙古和满洲击败了那延和其他传统主义博尔济金王子的军队。
te: Kublai Khan defeats the force of Nayan and other traditionalist Borjigin princes in East Mongolia and Manchuria.
dz: 忽必烈在东蒙古和满洲击败了那延和其他传统主义博尔济金王子的军队。
de: Kublai Khan defeats the force of Nayan and other traditionalist Borjigin princes in East Mongolia and Manchuria.

t: 劳里亚的罗杰手下的阿拉贡斯分舰队在靠近那不勒斯的伯爵之战中击败了一支安热文分舰队.
te: The Aragonese fleet under Roger of Lauria defeats a Angevin fleet in the Battle of the Counts close to Naples.
dz: 劳里亚的罗杰手下的阿拉贡斯分舰队在靠近那不勒斯的伯爵之战中击败了一支安热文分舰队.
de: The Aragonese fleet under Roger of Lauria defeats a Angevin fleet in the Battle of the Counts close to Naples.

t: 荷兰须德海海堤倒塌，造成 50,000 多人死亡。
te: The Zuiderzee sea wall in the Netherlands collapses, killing over 50,000 people.
dz: 圣卢西亚洪水：荷兰须德海海堤倒塌，造成 50,000 多人死亡。
de: St. Lucia's flood: The Zuiderzee sea wall in the Netherlands collapses, killing over 50,000 people.
